annotation.title_clean: Loi modifiant le Code de la sécurité routière et d'autres dispositions (Projet de loi no 165, 2018, chapitre 7)
annotation.title_en: Act to amend the Highway Safety Code and other provisions (Bill 165, 2018, c. 7)
annotation.summary_en: Quebec Act 165 (2018) broadly amends the Highway Safety Code on road safety, distracted driving, cyclists, and impaired driving. It also defines autonomous vehicles by SAE J3016 levels 3–5, bans their circulation except level 3 vehicles sold in Canada, and enables ministerial pilot projects of up to five years with special insurance and liability rules.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines 'véhicule autonome' as SAE J3016 level 3, 4 or 5 vehicle (art. 4).
Art. 492.8 prohibits putting autonomous vehicles into circulation, except level 3 vehicles whose sale is allowed in Canada.
Art. 633.1 lets the Minister authorise pilot projects for autonomous vehicles, lasting five years, extendable up to two years, overriding the Code and the Automobile Insurance Act.
Minister may exempt insurance contributions, set minimum liability insurance, and require manufacturers or distributors to reimburse the Société for indemnities.
Broader road safety measures: prudence principle, distracted driving bans, ignition interlocks, new-driver curfews.
